definitionEn:
v. walk impeded by some physical limitation or injury
v. proceed slowly or with difficulty
s. not firm
s. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience
definitionZh: n. 跛行\na. 柔软的, 无力的, 软弱的\nvi. 跛行

example.text: After twisting his ankle during the game, he had to walk with a limp for a week.
example.translationZh: 比赛中扭伤脚踝后，他不得不一瘸一拐地走了一个星期。

definitionEn:
n. a formation of people or things one beside another
n. a mark that is long relative to its width
n. a formation of people or things one behind another
n. a length (straight or curved) without breadth or thickness; the trace of a moving point
definitionZh:
n. 列, 线, 绳, 电线, 线路, 路线, 航线, 作业线, 界线, 战线, 外形, 排, 家系
vt. 排成一行, 顺...排列, 划线于, 加衬里, 使有线条, 使起皱纹
vi. 排队
[计] 线路

example.text: Please line up in an orderly manner.
example.translationZh: 请有序排队。

definitionEn:
a. designating or involving an equation whose terms are of the first degree
a. of or in or along or relating to a line; involving a single dimension
s. (of a leaf shape) long and narrow
s. measured lengthwise
definitionZh: a. 线的, 直线的, 线状的\n[计] 线性

example.text: The students learned how to solve a linear equation with one variable.
example.translationZh: 学生们学习了如何解一元线性方程。

definitionEn: n. a fabric woven with fibers from the flax plant\nn. a high-quality paper made of linen fibers or with a linen finish\nn. white goods or clothing made with linen cloth
definitionZh: n. 亚麻布, 亚麻线, 亚麻制品\na. 亚麻布制的, 亚麻的

example.text: She spread a fresh linen tablecloth over the dining table before the guests arrived.
example.translationZh: 客人到来之前，她在餐桌上铺了一块干净的亚麻桌布。

definitionEn: n. (baseball) a hit that flies straight out from the batter\nn. a piece of cloth that is used as the inside surface of a garment\nn. a large commercial ship (especially one that carries passengers on a regular schedule)
definitionZh: n. 班机, 划线者, 定期船, 衬里\n[化] 衬垫; 垫带; 套管

example.text: The Titanic was a famous ocean liner that sank in 1912.
example.translationZh: 泰坦尼克号是一艘著名的远洋客轮，于1912年沉没。

definitionEn: v. remain present although waning or gradually dying\nv. take one's time; proceed slowly
definitionZh: vi. 逗留, 消磨, 徘徊\nvt. 消磨

example.text: The smell of coffee lingered in the kitchen long after breakfast.
example.translationZh: 早餐过后很久，厨房里仍弥漫着咖啡的香味。

definitionEn: n. the scientific study of language\nn. the humanistic study of language and literature
definitionZh: n. 语言学

example.text: She is studying linguistics at university because she wants to understand how languages change over time.
example.translationZh: 她在大学学习语言学，因为她想了解语言是如何随着时间而变化的。

definitionEn:
n large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male
n a celebrity who is lionized (much sought after)
n (astrology) a person who is born while the sun is in Leo
n the fifth sign of the zodiac; the sun is in this sign from about July 23 to August 22
definitionZh: n. 腰角；雄狮；狮子（lion的复数）

example.text: The lions rested in the shade of the acacia tree, waiting for dusk to hunt.
example.translationZh: 狮群在金合欢树的阴凉处休息，等待黄昏时去捕猎。

definitionEn: n. an alcoholic beverage that is distilled rather than fermented\nn. a liquid substance that is a solution (or emulsion or suspension) used or obtained in an industrial process\nn. the liquid in which vegetables or meat have be cooked
definitionZh: n. 酒, 液体, 汁, 溶液\nvt. 浸水\nvi. 喝酒

example.text: She can hold her liquor better than anyone else at the party.
example.translationZh: 她在聚会上比其他任何人都更能喝而不醉。

definitionEn:
n. a database containing an ordered array of items (names or topics)
v. give or make a list of; name individually; give the names of
v. include in a list
v. cause to lean to the side
definitionZh:
n. 目录, 名单, 明细表, 布条, 条纹, 列表, 序列, 数据清单
vt. 列出, 列于表上, 记入名单内, 装布条
vi. 列于表上
[计] 列表, 序列, 数据清单

example.text: Before going shopping, she made a list of everything she needed.
example.translationZh: 去购物之前，她把需要的东西都列了一张清单。

definitionEn: n. the ability to read and write
definitionZh: n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学

example.text: The school offers free classes to help adults improve their literacy skills.
example.translationZh: 这所学校提供免费课程，帮助成年人提高读写能力。

definitionEn: r. in a literal sense\nr. (intensifier before a figurative expression) without exaggeration
definitionZh: adv. 逐字地, 按照字面上地, 不夸张地

example.text: When she said she would kill him, I don't think she meant you to take it literally.
example.translationZh: 当她说要杀了他时，我认为她并不是要你按字面意思理解。

definitionEn:
n. creative writing of recognized artistic value
n. the humanistic study of a body of literature
n. published writings in a particular style on a particular subject
n. the profession or art of a writer
definitionZh: n. 文学, 文艺, 著作\n[经] 广告, 商品介绍等文学

example.text: She studied English literature at university and later became a teacher.
example.translationZh: 她大学时学习英国文学，后来成了一名教师。

definitionEn:
n. the offspring at one birth of a multiparous mammal
n. rubbish carelessly dropped or left about (especially in public places)
n. conveyance consisting of a chair or bed carried on two poles by bearers
v. strew
definitionZh: n. 垃圾, 杂乱, 轿, 担架\nvt. 乱丢, 铺草, 弄乱\nvi. 产仔, 乱丢垃圾

example.text: Please do not drop litter in the park; use the bins provided.
example.translationZh: 请不要在公园里乱扔垃圾，请使用提供的垃圾桶。

definitionEn:
v. lead a certain kind of life; live in a certain style
v. pursue a positive and satisfying existence
a. actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing
a. exerting force or containing energy
definitionZh:
a. 活的, 生动的, 精力充沛的, 实况转播的
vi. 活, 生存, 居住
vt. 过着, 度过, 经历
adv. 实况地

example.text: She has lived abroad for ten years.
example.translationZh: 她已经在国外生活了十年。

definitionEn: n. any animals kept for use or profit
definitionZh: n. 家畜\n[经] 牲畜, 家畜

example.text: The family has raised livestock on this farm for generations.
example.translationZh: 这家人世世代代在这个农场饲养家畜。

definitionEn: n. a quantity of food (other than bread) formed in a particular shape
definitionZh: n. 一条面包, 块, 游荡\nv. 游手好闲, 虚度光阴

example.text: She bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery.
example.translationZh: 她从面包店买了一条新鲜的面包。

definitionEn: n. the temporary provision of money (usually at interest)
definitionZh: n. 贷款, 借出\nv. 借, 供应货款, 借给

example.text: They took out a loan to buy their first house.
example.translationZh: 他们申请了一笔贷款来买第一套房子。

definitionEn: n the temporary provision of money (usually at interest)\nn a word borrowed from another language; e.g. `blitz' is a German word borrowed into modern English\nv give temporarily; let have for a limited time
definitionZh: n. 借贷；贷款（loan的复数形式）

example.text: The bank offers low-interest loans to small businesses.
example.translationZh: 这家银行向小企业提供低息贷款。

definitionEn: s. unwillingness to do something contrary to your custom
definitionZh: a. 不情愿的, 厌恶的

example.text: She was loath to admit that she had made a mistake.
example.translationZh: 她不愿意承认自己犯了错误。

definitionEn: n. the people who support some common cause or business or principle or sectional interest\nn. a group of people who try actively to influence legislation\nv. detain in conversation by or as if by holding on to the outer garments of; as for political or economic favors
definitionZh: n. 大厅, 休息室, 游说议员者\nvi. 游说议员, 游说\nvt. 游说

example.text: Environmental groups plan to lobby the government for stricter emission limits.
example.translationZh: 环保团体计划游说政府制定更严格的排放限制。

definitionEn:
n. public transport consisting of a bus or train that stops at all stations or stops
a. relating to or applicable to or concerned with the administration of a city or town or district rather than a larger area
a. of or belonging to or characteristic of a particular locality or neighborhood
a. affecting only a restricted part or area of the body
definitionZh: a. 地方性的, 当地的, 局部的, 乡土的, 本地的\nn. 当地居民, 本地新闻, 局部\n[计] 本地的; 局部

example.text: We arrived in Tokyo at 3 p.m. local time.
example.translationZh: 我们在当地时间下午3点到达东京。

definitionEn: n a surrounding or nearby region
definitionZh: n. 地方, 所在, 位置\n[法] 位置, 场所, 地区

example.text: The police asked residents in the locality whether they had seen the missing dog.
example.translationZh: 警方询问了当地居民是否见过那只走失的狗。

definitionEn: n. a point or extent in space\nn. a workplace away from a studio at which some or all of a movie may be made
definitionZh: n. 位置, 场所, 特定区域\n[计] 位置

example.text: The crew spent three weeks at a remote filming location in the mountains.
example.translationZh: 剧组在山区一个偏远的拍摄地点待了三周。

definitionEn:
n a point or extent in space
n the act of putting something in a certain place
n a determination of the place where something is
n a workplace away from a studio at which some or all of a movie may be made
definitionZh: n. 位置；定位件；地点（location的复数）

example.text: The production team scouted several locations before choosing the seaside town.
example.translationZh: 制作团队在选定这个海滨小镇之前勘察了好几个地点。

definitionEn:
n. a fastener fitted to a door or drawer to keep it firmly closed
n. a strand or cluster of hair
n. a mechanism that detonates the charge of a gun
n. enclosure consisting of a section of canal that can be closed to control the water level; used to raise or lower vessels that pass through it
definitionZh: n. 锁, 刹车, 水闸, 一缕头发\nvt. 锁, 锁上, 拘禁, 隐藏, (用锁等)拴住, 刹住\nvi. 锁住, (齿轮等)啮合, (船)过闸

example.text: Please lock the door before you leave the office.
example.translationZh: 离开办公室前请把门锁上。

definitionEn: n. a fastener that locks or closes
definitionZh: n. 抽屉, 小柜, 上锁人\n[机] 锁柜

example.text: He left his towel and shoes in his locker after the game.
example.translationZh: 比赛结束后，他把毛巾和鞋子留在了自己的储物柜里。

definitionEn: n. a wheeled vehicle consisting of a self-propelled engine that is used to draw trains along railway tracks\na. of or relating to locomotion
definitionZh: n. 火车头, 机车\na. 运转的, 火车头的, 移动的

example.text: The old steam locomotive pulled the passenger cars along the mountain railway.
example.translationZh: 那辆老式蒸汽机车沿着山区铁路牵引着客车车厢。

definitionEn:
n. English physicist who studied electromagnetic radiation and was a pioneer of radiotelegraphy (1851-1940)
n. small house at the entrance to the grounds of a country mansion; usually occupied by a gatekeeper or gardener
n. a small (rustic) house used as a temporary shelter
n. any of various Native American dwellings
definitionZh: n. 小屋, 门房, 支部, 旅舍, 分会\nvi. 临时住宿, 倒伏, 寄宿, 投宿\nvt. 安顿, 容纳, 提出, 把...射入, 存放

example.text: She decided to lodge a complaint with the hotel manager about the noise.
example.translationZh: 她决定就噪音问题向酒店经理提出投诉。

definitionEn: n. the act of lodging
definitionZh: n. 寄宿处, 寄宿\n[法] 提起, 住所

example.text: We spent the night in cheap lodging near the station.
example.translationZh: 我们在车站附近便宜的住处过了一夜。

definitionEn: s of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style\ns of imposing height; especially standing out above others\ns having or displaying great dignity or nobility
definitionZh: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的

example.text: She moved to the city with lofty ambitions and a determination to succeed.
example.translationZh: 她怀着崇高的抱负和成功的决心搬到了这座城市。

definitionEn:
n. a segment of the trunk of a tree when stripped of branches
n. a written record of messages sent or received
n. a written record of events on a voyage (of a ship or plane)
n. measuring instrument that consists of a float that trails from a ship by a knotted line in order to measure the ship's speed through the water
definitionZh:
n. 记录, 圆木, 日志, 计程仪
vt. 伐木, 切, 航行
vi. 伐木
[计] 日志

example.text: The captain ordered the crew to keep a detailed log of the voyage.
example.translationZh: 船长命令船员详细记录航行日志。

definitionEn: v hang loosely or laxly\nv be lazy or idle
definitionZh: vi. 懒散地闲荡, 垂下头, 伸舌\nvt. 垂, 伸, 靠着

example.text: After lunch, he lolled about on the sofa all afternoon.
example.translationZh: 午饭后，他在沙发上懒洋洋地躺了一下午。

phrase.translationZh: 懒洋洋地闲躺；无所事事地消磨时间

definitionEn: n. the capital and largest city of England; located on the Thames in southeastern England; financial and industrial and cultural center\nn. United States writer of novels based on experiences in the Klondike gold rush (1876-1916)
definitionZh: n. 伦敦

example.text: They plan to visit London next summer to see the famous landmarks.
example.translationZh: 他们计划明年夏天去伦敦游览，看看那些著名的地标。

definitionEn: n. the angular distance between a point on any meridian and the prime meridian at Greenwich
definitionZh: n. 经度, 经线\n[电] 经度

example.text: The ship's position was recorded by latitude and longitude.
example.translationZh: 这艘船的位置是用纬度和经度记录下来的。

definitionEn:
n. a textile machine for weaving yarn into a textile
v. come into view indistinctly, often threateningly
v. appear very large or occupy a commanding position
v. weave on a loom
definitionZh: n. 织布机, 若隐若现的景象\nvi. 朦胧地出现, 隐约可见, 可怕地出现

example.text: Dark clouds loomed on the horizon before the storm.
example.translationZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云在地平线上隐约浮现。

definitionEn:
n. anything with a round or oval shape (formed by a curve that is closed and does not intersect itself)
n. an inner circle of advisors (especially under President Reagan)
n. the basic pattern of the human fingerprint
n. a computer program that performs a series of instructions repeatedly until some specified condition is satisfied
definitionZh:
n. 环, 圈, 弯曲部分, 循环
vt. 使成环, 以圈结, 以环连结
vi. 打环, 翻筋斗
[计] 循环

example.text: The trail loops back to the parking lot after about two miles.
example.translationZh: 这条小径大约两英里后绕回停车场。

definitionEn:
n. something that is lost
n. gradual decline in amount or activity
n. the act of losing someone or something
n. the disadvantage that results from losing something
definitionZh: n. 损失, 遗失, 失败, 输, 错过, 伤亡\n[化] 损失; 损耗

example.text: The company reported a net loss of two million dollars last year.
example.translationZh: 该公司去年报告净亏损两百万美元。

definitionEn: s unwillingness to do something contrary to your custom\ns (usually followed by `to') strongly opposed
definitionZh: a. 不愿意的, 厌恶的

example.text: She was loth to leave the party early, but she had an early flight the next morning.
example.translationZh: 她不情愿提早离开聚会，但第二天一早还要赶飞机。

phrase.translationZh: 不愿做某事；不情愿做某事

definitionEn: n. something that is regarded as a chance event\nn. players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
definitionZh: n. 奖券, 彩票, 运气\n[经] 抽彩给奖法

example.text: She bought a ticket on a whim and ended up winning the lottery.
example.translationZh: 她一时兴起买了张彩票，结果竟然中了奖。

definitionEn: n. a room (as in a hotel or airport) with seating where people can wait\nv. sit or recline comfortably
definitionZh: n. 闲逛, 休闲室, 长沙发\nvi. 闲混, (懒洋洋地)躺\nvt. 闲混

example.text: We spent the afternoon lounging around the hotel lobby, waiting for our flight.
example.translationZh: 我们整个下午都在酒店大堂闲逛，等待我们的航班。

definitionEn: Involving little or no risk; not likely to cause harm or danger.
definitionZh: [医]低危的, 低风险的

example.text: The doctor recommended a low-risk surgery for the elderly patient.
example.translationZh: 医生为这位老年患者推荐了一种低风险手术。

definitionEn: a. steadfast in allegiance or duty
definitionZh: a. 忠诚的, 忠实的, 忠贞的

example.text: The small bookshop has been rewarded with a loyal customer base for over thirty years.
example.translationZh: 这家小书店三十多年来赢得了一批忠实的顾客。

definitionEn: v. have lubricating properties\nv. apply a lubricant to\nv. make slippery or smooth through the application of a lubricant
definitionZh: vt. 使润滑, 涂油\nvi. 润滑

example.text: You should lubricate the engine regularly to keep it running smoothly.
example.translationZh: 你应该定期给发动机加润滑油，以保持其平稳运转。

definitionEn: s. having a clear mind
definitionZh: a. 明晰的, 清澈的, 透明的, 透彻的\n[医] 清明的, 透明的, 清醒的

example.text: Her lucid explanation helped everyone understand the complicated issue.
example.translationZh: 她清晰的解释帮助每个人理解了这个复杂的问题。

definitionEn: n. an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another\nn. an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that leads to a favorable outcome
definitionZh: n. 运气, 幸运, 好运, 侥幸\nvi. 靠好运成功

example.text: I wish you good luck on your exam.
example.translationZh: 祝你考试好运。

definitionEn: s. producing a sizeable profit
definitionZh: a. 有利益的, 获利的, 合算的

example.text: She turned her hobby into a lucrative business within two years.
example.translationZh: 她在两年内把自己的爱好变成了一门利润丰厚的生意。

definitionEn: s broadly or extravagantly humorous; resembling farce\ns incongruous; inviting ridicule
definitionZh: a. 可笑的, 滑稽的, 荒唐的

example.text: The idea that we could finish the project in one day was ludicrous.
example.translationZh: 认为我们能在一天内完成这个项目的想法是荒谬的。

definitionEn: n. a period of calm weather\nv. calm by deception\nv. become quiet or less intensive
definitionZh: n. 暂停, 间歇, 稍息, 使人安静的东西\nvt. 使平静, 哄骗, 使安静\nvi. 变平静

example.text: There was a sudden lull in the conversation, and everyone looked at the door.
example.translationZh: 谈话突然停顿下来，大家都看向门口。

definitionEn: s softly bright or radiant
definitionZh: a. 发光的, 明亮的\n[医] 发光的

example.text: The watch hands are coated with luminous paint so you can read the time in the dark.
example.translationZh: 表针上涂有发光涂料，因此你在黑暗中也能看清时间。

definitionEn: v. put together indiscriminately
definitionZh: n. 块, 瘤, 很多, 肿块, 笨人\nvt. 使成块状, 混在一起\nvi. 结块

example.text: He took the whole amount as a lump sum instead of monthly payments.
example.translationZh: 他没有按月领取，而是一次性领取了全部金额。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to or associated with the moon
definitionZh: a. 阴历的, 月的, 微亮的(指光)\n[医] 月的, 银的

example.text: The Lunar New Year is celebrated by many communities across Asia.
example.translationZh: 亚洲许多社群都会庆祝农历新年。

definitionEn: n. a midday meal\nv. take the midday meal\nv. provide a midday meal for
definitionZh: n. 午餐

example.text: We usually have lunch at noon.
example.translationZh: 我们通常中午吃午饭。

definitionEn: n. qualities that attract by seeming to promise some kind of reward
definitionZh: n. 饵, 诱惑\nvt. 引诱, 诱惑

example.text: The promise of easy money lured many young people into the scheme.
example.translationZh: 轻松赚钱的承诺引诱许多年轻人卷入了这个骗局。

definitionEn: v. lie in wait, lie in ambush, behave in a sneaky and secretive manner
definitionZh: n. 潜伏, 潜行\nvi. 暗藏, 潜伏, 埋伏\n[计] 隐匿阅读

example.text: The cat lurked behind the bushes, waiting to pounce on the bird.
example.translationZh: 那只猫潜伏在灌木丛后面，伺机扑向那只鸟。

definitionEn: n. something that is an indulgence rather than a necessity\nn. wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living
definitionZh: n. 奢侈, 豪华\na. 奢侈的, 豪华的

example.text: She treated herself to a luxury spa weekend after months of hard work.
example.translationZh: 在数月的辛勤工作之后，她犒劳自己去享受了一个奢华的温泉周末。

definitionEn:
n. any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
n. an efficient person
n. an intricate organization that accomplishes its goals efficiently
n. a device for overcoming resistance at one point by applying force at some other point
definitionZh: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构, 自动售货机, 机械般工作的人\nvt. 以机器制造

example.text: The washing machine broke down, so we had to wash our clothes by hand.
example.translationZh: 洗衣机坏了，所以我们只好用手洗衣服。

definitionEn:
n any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
n an efficient person
n an intricate organization that accomplishes its goals efficiently

definitionZh: n. 网孔, 网丝, 网眼, 网状物, 圈套, 陷阱, 啮合\nvt. 以网捕捉, 啮合, 使缠住\nvi. 落网, 相啮合

example.text: The fence is made of fine wire mesh to keep small animals out.
example.translationZh: 这道围栏由细金属丝网制成，用来挡住小动物。

definitionEn:
n. a state of confusion and disorderliness
n. soft semiliquid food
n. a meal eaten in a mess hall by service personnel
n. a (large) military dining room where service personnel eat or relax
definitionZh: n. 食堂, 伙食, 用膳, 一份食品, 混乱, 乱七八糟, 困境\nvt. 将...弄糟, 妨碍, 使紊乱, 使就餐\nvi. 陷入困境, 搞乱, 用膳

example.text: The kitchen was in a terrible mess after the party, so we spent the whole morning cleaning it up.
example.translationZh: 派对结束后厨房一片狼藉，所以我们花了一整个上午打扫。

definitionEn: n. the organic processes (in a cell or organism) that are necessary for life
definitionZh: n. 新陈代谢, 变态\n[化] 新陈代谢; 代谢

example.text: Regular exercise can help boost your metabolism and burn more calories.
example.translationZh: 规律运动有助于促进新陈代谢，燃烧更多卡路里。

definitionEn: v. cover with metal
definitionZh: n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料\na. 金属制的\nvt. 以金属覆盖

example.text: The bridge is made of strong metal.
example.translationZh: 这座桥是用坚固的金属制成的。

definitionEn: n. a fabric made of a yarn that is partly or entirely of metal\nn. a yarn made partly or entirely of metal\na. containing or made of or resembling or characteristic of a metal
definitionZh: a. 金属的, 含金属的, 产生金属的\n[经] 金属的

example.text: The water had a strange metallic taste.
example.translationZh: 这水有一股奇怪的金属味。

definitionEn: n. a figure of speech in which an expression is used to refer to something that it does not literally denote in order to suggest a similarity
definitionZh: n. 隐喻

example.text: Her essay uses the metaphor of a journey to describe the process of learning a language.
example.translationZh: 她的文章用旅程的隐喻来描述学习语言的过程。

definitionEn: a. pertaining to or consisting of meteors or meteoroids\ns. like a meteor in speed or brilliance or transience
definitionZh: a. 流星的, 疾速的, 大气的

example.text: The young singer's meteoric rise to fame surprised everyone in the industry.
example.translationZh: 这位年轻歌手的一夜成名让业内所有人都感到惊讶。

definitionEn: n. predicting what the weather will be\nn. the earth science dealing with phenomena of the atmosphere (especially weather)
definitionZh: n. 气象学, 气象状态\n[医] 气象学

example.text: She decided to study meteorology to better understand climate patterns.
example.translationZh: 她决定学习气象学，以更好地理解气候模式。

definitionEn: n a way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)\nn an acting technique introduced by Stanislavsky in which the actor recalls emotions or reactions from his or her own life and uses them to identify with the character being portrayed
definitionZh: n. 方法, 方式；研究方法（method的复数）

example.text: The team compared several teaching methods before choosing the one that worked best.
example.translationZh: 团队比较了几种教学方法，然后选择了效果最好的那一种。

definitionEn: s. marked by precise accordance with details\ns. marked by extreme care in treatment of details
definitionZh: a. 一丝不苟的, 精确的, 过细的

example.text: She is meticulous in keeping accurate records of every experiment.
example.translationZh: 她一丝不苟地记录每一次实验。

definitionEn: a. based on the meter as a standard of measurement
definitionZh: a. 公尺的, 公制的, 计量的\n[医] 测量的, 米制的, 公制的

example.text: Most countries use the metric system for everyday measurements.
example.translationZh: 大多数国家在日常测量中使用公制。

definitionEn: n. in the Eastern Orthodox Church this title is given to a position between bishop and patriarch; equivalent to archbishop in western Christianity\nn. a person who lives in a metropolis\na. relating to or characteristic of a metropolis
definitionZh: n. 大都市居民, 都主教, 宗主国的公民\na. 大都市的, 都主教区的, 宗主国的

example.text: The metropolitan area has a population of over ten million.
example.translationZh: 这个大都市区的人口超过一千万。

definitionEn: n. a minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
definitionZh: n. 微生物, 细菌\n[医] 微生物

example.text: Washing your hands helps prevent harmful microbes from entering your body.
example.translationZh: 洗手有助于防止有害微生物进入你的身体。

definitionEn: n. the branch of biology that studies microorganisms and their effects on humans
definitionZh: n. 微生物学\n[化] 微生物学

example.text: She majored in microbiology and now works in a hospital laboratory.
example.translationZh: 她主修微生物学，现在在一家医院实验室工作。

definitionEn: n. a miniature model of something
definitionZh: n. 小宇宙, 小世界, 人类

example.text: The small village is a microcosm of the whole country.
example.translationZh: 这个小村庄是整个国家的缩影。

definitionEn: n. film on which materials are photographed at greatly reduced size; useful for storage; a magnification system is used to read the material\nv. record on microfilm
definitionZh: n. 缩影胶卷\nv. 缩微拍摄\n[计] 缩微胶片; 缩微胶卷

example.text: The old newspapers have been stored on microfilm for easier access.
example.translationZh: 旧报纸已以缩微胶卷形式保存，以便查阅。

definitionEn: n. device for converting sound waves into electrical energy
definitionZh: n. 扩音器, 麦克风\n[医] 扩音器, 传声器

example.text: Please speak directly into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
example.translationZh: 请直接对着麦克风说话，这样大家都能听到你。

definitionEn: s. used in combination to denote the middle
definitionZh: a. 中间的, 中央的, 中部的\nprep. 在...之中

example.text: We met in the mid afternoon, when the sun was no longer at its strongest.
example.translationZh: 我们在下午中段见面，那时阳光已经不那么强烈了。

definitionEn: The middle part of the morning, roughly around 10 a.m.
definitionZh: n. 上午十时左右

example.text: We took a short break in the midmorning to stretch our legs.
example.translationZh: 我们在上午十点左右短暂休息了一下，活动活动腿脚。

definitionEn: n. 12 o'clock at night; the middle of the night
definitionZh: n. 午夜, 子夜, 半夜\na. 午夜的, 半夜的

example.text: The train leaves at midnight, so we should get to the station by eleven.
example.translationZh: 火车午夜出发，所以我们得在十一点前到车站。

definitionEn: n. physical strength
definitionZh: n. 力量, 权力\naux. 可能, 也许

example.text: She might well be right about the schedule.
example.translationZh: 关于这个日程安排，她很可能是对的。

definitionEn: s. having or showing great strength or force or intensity\nr. (Southern regional intensive) very; to a great degree
definitionZh: n. 有势力的人\na. 有势力的, 强大的, 有力的\nadv. 很, 极

example.text: The village still tells stories about the mighty warrior who defended them long ago.
example.translationZh: 村里至今仍流传着那位很久以前保卫他们的强大战士的故事。

definitionEn: n. the movement of persons from one country or locality to another\nn. a group of people migrating together (especially in some given time period)\nn. (chemistry) the nonrandom movement of an atom or radical from one place to another within a molecule
definitionZh: n. 移民, 移往, 移动\n[计] 迁移

example.text: The region experienced a mass migration of workers to the coastal cities.
example.translationZh: 该地区经历了工人向沿海城市的大规模迁移。

definitionEn: a. used of animals that move seasonally
definitionZh: a. 迁移的, 流浪的

example.text: Every autumn, thousands of migratory birds fly south to escape the cold winter.
example.translationZh: 每年秋天，成千上万的候鸟飞往南方以躲避寒冷的冬天。

definitionEn: n. the process of becoming mildewed\nn. a fungus that produces a superficial (usually white) growth on organic matter
definitionZh: n. 霉\nvi. 发霉, 生霉\nvt. 使发霉

example.text: The damp walls in the basement were covered with mildew.
example.translationZh: 地下室潮湿的墙壁上长满了霉。

definitionEn: n. distance measured in miles\nn. the ratio of the number of miles traveled to the number of gallons of gasoline burned\nn. a travel allowance at a given rate per mile traveled
definitionZh: n. 英里数\n[经] 运费(按英里计算的)

example.text: The car's annual mileage is about 12,000 miles.
example.translationZh: 这辆车的年行驶里程约为12000英里。
